data.name: Voicemail of God
data.detailed_description:
Voicemail of God is a satirical narrative puzzle game where you become the stand-in for a missing deity.

God has gone on galactic vacation, leaving only an answering machine behind. Now it’s your job — a lowly call center worker — to pick up the prayers.

Every day, a new flood of bizarre, desperate, and absurd messages comes in. Your answers ripple across entire worlds: you might save a village, doom a civilization, or simply give someone a little hope.

🌀 What Awaits You

  • 📞 Answer Prayers as Tickets – Each call feels like a support ticket; your reply changes destinies.

  • 😇 What Kind of God Are You? – Your choices reveal the divine persona you’re accidentally shaping.

  • 🌀 Absurd Comedy Meets Melancholy – God is gone, but people still call.

  • 📅 30-Day Cycle – Survive an escalating month of requests.

  • 🔮 Multiple Endings – See what kind of “God Report” your decisions create.

✨ Key Features

  • Satirical narrative adventure with surreal humor

  • 30-day loop, with new prayers each day

  • Branching choices → different divine archetypes

  • Call-center mechanics reimagined as prayer management

  • Multiple endings for replayability
